_comment: Homebrew override layer for Cythranai. Hand-maintained and LOCKED; merged onto Wood Elf OWB data every time tools/update-data.py runs, so OWB refreshes never overwrite it. FOUR operations (all optional): 'units' = net-new custom units (added alongside official). 'patches' = {officialId: {field: value}} edit only the named fields of an official unit; everything else keeps flowing from OWB; e.g. "patches": {"glade-lord": {"points": 120}}. 'replace' = {officialId: {full unit}} swap an official unit wholesale. 'remove' = [officialId, ...] hide official units you don't field. To ACCEPT an upstream change you've been overriding, delete that patch entry. Field notes: 'points' = cost at minimum size; 'perModel' = each extra model (null for single models). In a patch, a list field REPLACES the official list wholesale (restate all entries). STANDING RULE remains: Cythranai characters draw magic items from ALL elf lists (Wood/High/Dark Elf + general) via itemSources — inert until a character is given a magicAllowances picker.

deepwood-scouts.notes: House rule: may take Light armour and an Additional hand weapon (both free).

deepwood-scouts-core.notes: House rule: may take Light armour and an Additional hand weapon (both free).

glade-riders.notes: House rule: may take Light armour (free).

dryads.notes: House rule: 5+ armour save (was light/Sapwood 6+). 12 pts/model (was 13).

units.name: Gareth, Tyhîr
units.notes: Tyhîr of Teimanëar. Of Caledor. Must lead Yár'laithîr. Holds Vhailor Sarthai. All-in: Glade Lord chassis + Huarath (65pt monstrous-cav mount) + Biting Blade, Merciw's Locus, Aspect of the Bear (items <=100). Anvil-general, T5 in play. Must lead Yár'laithîr.

units.name: Daedilae on Lothaqshynin
units.notes: High Priestess of the Cult. Blade Fëalana. High Priestess on the dragon Lothaqshynin, Level 3 wizard + Aspect of the Cat. Flying hammer / character-killer (Killing Blow + Armour Bane).

units.name: Rephal Morgeil
units.notes: Gareth's bodyguard/assassin. High-ranking. Not lieutenant. Distinct from Tirkinthil. Waystalker chassis + 2-shot Sword of Sorrow (~40) + Manbane (10). Character-assassin: AP, always-wound sniping.

units.name: High Priestess of Khul Anar (foot)
units.notes: On-foot caster; 5+ ward (blessing), Spear of Loec w/ Flame Bloom, Strike First + Killing Blow. Optional decapitation blade.

units.name: Felmorën
units.notes: Cult of Khul Anar. Highest members short of the high priests. They follow Daedilae. Enchanted armour and weapons. Descend from the sky too fast for the eye. Blend Wardancer mimetic magic of Loec with Sisters of Slaughter ferocity. Deadliest weapons the Cult wields for their patron. In battle they don war-masks covering the eyes, enter a trance, and fight by instinct and the Winds of Magic. Brutality and skill unmatched on Athel Cythrel. Daedilae made the choreography; they dance it. Distinct from the Templars of Morngal (Spirit Eyes). Winged elves; flight from enchanted wings in the armour. 22 pts, A3, T3 W2, 5+/5+, Mooncleaver Falchion, Sundering Blow, Shrouded in Mist. Heavenly Headsmen = Hatred + Flaming. Harvesters of Fear stands.

units.name: Yár'laithîr
units.notes: Gareth's lord-knights. Each is a Yár'laithîr. They follow Gareth alone. Tirkinthil is not one of them and they do not answer to him. Monstrous cavalry. Repeatable for MSU. W3, Red Blessing once per combat.
